entities.summary: Joakim Eriksson is a retired Swedish professional ice hockey player and general manager. He has previously played for SHL teams Djurgårdens IF, Linköpings HC and Södertälje SK. Eriksson also played in Finland for Espoo Blues and HIFK in the SM-liiga.
